title: Great guide and customizable experience
text: We had a great time. Our tour guide Michael was the best. Very knowledgeable and attentive to our needs. We were able to customize our experience to our liking. Would highly recommend to others.
author: Beira_M

title: Outstanding excursion
text: One day trip to the Alpujarras. Very well organized. The guide, DANTE, very pleasant and friendly. Very timely scheduled visits and stops. The tasting of typical products is very good. The restaurant where we ate was also very good, although the menu could be improved. In short, outstanding for GRANAVISION and for the guide: DANTE. Both are totally recommended.
author: Luisrodriguezabad

title: Having been unable to get tickets...
text: Having been unable to get tickets for the Alhambra we decided we would like to get out of the city and head for the hills! This was an excellent trip up to Sierra Nevada which still had some snow on the tops. The ski season is finished so the area was very quiet. OUr guides were excellent and very knowledgeable about the area and its history. Not a full day but we were back in time for a siesta and then to see some more of Granada.
author: Jane D

title: If you want to see the Sierra Nevada...
text: If you want to see the Sierra Nevada mountains this was a very enjoyable way to experience it. Michael our tour guide was terrific, the views were spectacular and it was nice to have the flexibility of being on a private tour. When we showed up to meet Michael he was already there and the vehicle you provided was very comfortable. It truly was a memorable tour.
author: carolyn w
